# ZITERA_LAB Distribution Artifacts

This directory contains release distribution builds, checksums, and manifests generated by the release pipeline (`scripts/release/build_release.ps1`).

## Contents Layout

- `bin/`: Standalone executables (`zitera-engine.exe`)
- `packages/`: Verified signed lab modules (`.zlab`)
- `release_manifest.json`: Machine-readable canonical release metadata
- `checksums.sha256`: Standard SHA-256 integrity checksums
- `zitera-lab-<version>-windows-x64-portable.zip`: Complete portable zero-install bundle
